name: Tomodachi-kun
summary:
"Hello, this is Nikki.

I found this game on a Japanese abandonware site. Nobody seems to know anything about it, so I decided to translate it or at least as much as I could understand. It seems to be a very basic game. Collecting eggs probably unlocks the ending. Then again, I’m not actually playing it. The flying creature is just too creepy, something about that mustache sends chills down my spine...

I do wonder why nobody ever talks about it."
